description: Build the champion data model and the pre-battle React UI: a polished main menu and a League-style champion select screen. Define a typed roster of at least 5 distinct champions, each with base stats and a passive plus Q/W/E/R abilities (name/description via i18n keys, cooldowns, damage, ranges). Provide the champion-select screen where the player browses champions, reads their ability tooltips (fully localized ko/en), and locks in a pick, then transitions to the battle screen. Depends on FEAT-001.
steps: Create src/data/champions.ts exporting a typed Champion interface: id, nameKey, titleKey, role, stats { hp, hpRegen, moveSpeed, attackDamage, attackRange, attackSpeed }, an array of 4 abilities and one passive. Each Ability: slot ('P'|'Q'|'W'|'E'|'R'), nameKey, descKey, cooldown, cost, range, damage, and a typed behavior tag (e.g., 'skillshot' | 'dash' | 'buff' | 'aoe' | 'heal' | 'stun') the battle engine will interpret.

Define at least 5 champions with clearly different playstyles inspired by LoL archetypes (e.g., a ranged marksman, a mobile assassin with a dash, a tanky bruiser with CC, a burst mage with skillshots, a support/enchanter with a heal/shield). Use ORIGINAL champion names and lore to avoid trademark issues (do NOT copy Riot's champion names/lore); reference archetypes only. All display text via i18n keys.

Add all champion name/title/ability keys to src/i18n/locales/ko.json and en.json (keep identical key structure; the i18n parity test must still pass). Provide natural, high-quality Korean translations, not machine-literal.

Create src/screens/MainMenu.tsx: styled landing screen with game title, a Play button, the LanguageToggle, and a short tagline. Clicking Play routes to champion select. Use the screen router state from App.

Create src/screens/ChampionSelect.tsx: a champion grid/list (portraits or stylized cards using CSS - no external art required; use generated gradients/initials/emoji-free CSS art), a detail panel showing selected champion's stats and P/Q/W/E/R ability cards with localized tooltips, a 'Lock In' button that stores the chosen champion id and routes to battle. Also let the player pick an opponent (bot) champion or randomize it.
Create src/components/AbilityCard.tsx and src/components/ChampionCard.tsx reusable presentational components used by ChampionSelect and later the in-battle HUD.
Wire App.tsx router: menu -> select -> battle. Pass the selected player champion id and enemy champion id down to the battle screen (via context or props/state).
Add src/styles for the menu and select screens (League-inspired dark/gold theme, hover/selection states, responsive grid).

Add unit tests: src/data/champions.test.ts asserting every champion has exactly 4 abilities + 1 passive, unique ids, positive stats, and that every nameKey/descKey used by champions exists in BOTH ko.json and en.json (guards against missing translations). Add src/screens/ChampionSelect.test.tsx rendering the screen, selecting a champion, and asserting Lock In triggers the battle transition callback.
acceptance_criteria: At least 5 champions defined, each with 1 passive + 4 abilities (P/Q/W/E/R), unique ids and positive stats.
Every champion i18n key resolves in both ko and en locales (verified by champions.test.ts).
Champion select renders the roster, shows localized ability tooltips, and Lock In transitions to the battle screen (verified by ChampionSelect.test.tsx).
npm run test -- --run and npx tsc --noEmit both pass; npm run build succeeds.
findings:
Implemented FEAT-002 fully. Verification: `npm run test -- --run` = 31/31 passing (4 files), `npx tsc --noEmit` clean, `npm run build` succeeds and dist/index.html asset URLs are prefixed with /game-champs/. NOTE: repo root is /projects/sandbox/game-champs itself (app files at root, NOT nested), so verification commands were run from the repo root directly (the `cd game-champs` prefix in context/verification arrays assumes a parent dir that does not exist here).

WHAT WAS BUILT:
- src/data/champions.ts: exports Champion, Ability, ChampionStats, AbilitySlot ('P'|'Q'|'W'|'E'|'R'), AbilityBehavior ('skillshot'|'dash'|'buff'|'aoe'|'heal'|'stun'), ChampionRole. CHAMPIONS is `readonly Champion[]` with 5 original champions: ashborne (marksman), nightveil (assassin/dash), ironhold (bruiser/CC), embermage (burst mage), dawnsong (enchanter/heal). Each Champion has `passive` (slot 'P') + `abilities` tuple [Q,W,E,R]. Each also has `accentColor` (hex) used for CSS art. Helpers: getChampionById(id), getAllAbilities(champion) -> [passive, Q, W, E, R], randomChampionId(excludeId?), and ABILITY_SLOT_ORDER.
- i18n: added `champions.<id>.name/title` and `champions.<id>.<slot>.name/.desc` (P/Q/W/E/R) plus UI namespaces select.*, role.*, stat.*, ability.* (incl. ability.behavior.* and ability.seconds with {{value}}), slot.*, menu.tagline/play to BOTH ko.json and en.json (parity test passes). Korean is hand-written, not machine-literal.
- Components: src/components/AbilityCard.tsx and src/components/ChampionCard.tsx (CSS-art portrait from accentColor gradient + initials, no image assets). Both reusable for the FEAT-003 in-battle HUD.
- Screens: src/screens/MainMenu.tsx (onPlay prop) and src/screens/ChampionSelect.tsx (onLockIn(playerId, enemyId), optional onBack). Select has roster grid, stats grid, P/Q/W/E/R ability cards, opponent <select> picker + Randomize button. Default player = CHAMPIONS[0], enemy = random distinct.
- src/App.tsx: added `export interface MatchSetup { playerChampionId: string; enemyChampionId: string }`. Router state routes menu -> select -> battle. handleLockIn stores MatchSetup in state and sets screen to 'battle'. The 'battle' screen is still a PLACEHOLDER showing the two ids.
- CSS appended to src/styles/global.css (menu + champion-select, responsive grid collapses to 1 col <=860px).
- Tests: src/data/champions.test.ts (22 tests: >=5 champs, unique ids, exactly 4 abilities + 1 passive in slot order, positive stats, valid behavior tags, every name/desc key resolves in BOTH locales) and src/screens/ChampionSelect.test.tsx (6 tests: roster render, detail panel tooltips, selection change, Lock In fires callback with valid ids, opponent picker, back button).

FOR FEAT-003 (battle screen):
- Consume the selected ids via App's `match: MatchSetup | null` state. Replace the placeholder `screen === 'battle'` block in src/App.tsx with the Phaser battle component, passing match.playerChampionId and match.enemyChampionId (use getChampionById to hydrate full Champion objects).
- Champion data shape for the engine: champion.stats.{hp,hpRegen,moveSpeed,attackDamage,attackRange,attackSpeed}; each ability has {slot, cooldown, cost, range, damage, behavior}. The `behavior` tag is what the combat engine should switch on (skillshot=linear projectile, dash=reposition, buff=self/ally stat boost, aoe=area burst, heal=restore hp, stun=CC lockout). Passive is always-on (cooldown 0 for most).
- getAllAbilities(champion) returns [passive, Q, W, E, R] for building the HUD ability bar in slot order (ABILITY_SLOT_ORDER also exported).
- All display text is i18n keys; reuse AbilityCard/ChampionCard for the HUD. Any NEW strings must be added to BOTH ko.json and en.json (i18n.test.ts parity guard).
